decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 


	
The proposed siting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an inappropriate and obtrusive feature in the locality, the effect of which would unduly impact on the visual amenity in the area, particularly having regard to the adjoining two Conservation Areas.  The proposal is therefore contrary to policies  ENV B 1.1 and ENV B 1.7 and ENVB 2.2 of the  Unitary Development Plan and Planning Policy Guidance Note 8 Telecommunications.  The application is therefore refused permission due to siting and appearance.
description: Installation of 6 x antenna upon pole mounts and 4 x 600mm diameter dishes upon the main plant room. An equipment cabin and ancillary equipment are to be located at the lower roof level to rear of premises.
